text_block_list.text:
Having conquered the Kikuka-sho, Tokai 
Teio proudly held up three fingers toward 
the sky.

It was proof that she had reached the 
pinnacle of a "Triple Crown Umamusume," 
standing shoulder to shoulder with her 
idol, Symboli Rudolf.

However, Tokai Teio's challenge was far 
from over. In order to surpass Symboli 
Rudolf from here on out, she set her 
sights on the Tenno Sho (Spring).
